Welcome aboard—happy to walk you through it!

Sign up & trial: Create an account; we’ll build a custom plan and start a 2‑week trial, then regular deliveries every 4 weeks.
Set up your pup: Add age, weight, and activity level so portions are right.
Unpack & store: Let any dry ice disappear safely, then freeze meals and move a few to the fridge.
Transition slowly: Start with about 25% Nom Nom + 75% old food, then gradually increase over a week.
Check portions anytime: Your dog’s exact portions and feeding guide live in your online account.
Want to sample first? You can try our Variety Pack or single packs through Chewy, Amazon, or PetSmart before starting a subscription.

If you need more help, you can ask to speak to a customer representative agent.

Here’s a quick, simple rundown of your main options with us:

Try us out: Start with a two-week trial meal plan for your dog.
Customize meals: Pick recipes, portion sizes, and feeding frequency; set activity level so portions fit your pup.
Manage subscription: Change delivery dates, address, payment, and what’s in each box anytime before the order deadline.
Adjust pets: Add new dogs yourself; removing a dog currently requires chatting with a Pet Support Specialist.
Extras: Add treats and probiotics as a one-time add-on or in every box.
Portion guidance: View your dog’s feeding guide and exact portions in your online account.
Sampling without a subscription: Buy variety packs or single meals from Chewy, Amazon, or PetSmart if you want to test recipes without committing.
Costs & discounts: Price depends on your dog and choices; First Responders and Military Veterans can apply for a discount by reaching out to our team.

If you need more help, you can ask to speak to a customer representative agent.
